_readme: Hand-made mapping of rate-file EINs to the behavioral health platforms the outbound finding is for (DECISIONS #20). The rate file names entities, not their parents, so this is a reading, not data. confirmed is true only when the EIN's own name is the platform's; anything else stays unconfirmed, and its draft is blocked until someone confirms it.
